Each figure contains 24 plotted ticks carrying 25 species, and all 48 ticks were individually resolved. Two Fig. 11 ticks are each shared by two species whose leader lines converge on one point (Egyptian fruit bat + prairie dog; kangaroo rat + Jamaican fruit bat), and one Fig. 10 and one Fig. 11 label name two species; those species are given the same value and flagged in shares_tick_Fig10 / shares_tick_Fig11 -- their individual positions are INFERRED from a shared marker, not resolved.
